completed_v24_review.interpretation: Sparse-direction training fit does not transfer clearly; not universal fit worsening. Even label movement dominates clock-dependent verdicts.

implementation_guidance.continuation: Copy actor AND fixed encoder into permanent behavior snapshot modules once per outer burst; use sampled replay next_state forwards, not target actor or live fixed encoder. Target critic/encoder can still copy250.
implementation_guidance.replay_pair: Store shared source coordinates/noise and both first transitions atomically; never store latents, reuse historical lambda labels, or leak lane0. Historical initial distribution is a query; continuation is current snapshot.
implementation_guidance.complexity: Minibatch current-behavior relabeling avoids full-replay refresh65 times per burst. Fixed shapes can compile and capture.
implementation_guidance.sampling: Uniform replay point and paired sampling; actor/alpha still fresh main-only LAP.
implementation_guidance.representation: Prefer explicit joint critic+SALE historical coverage if v25 repeats odd transfer failure. No frozen encoder or actor replay. Disclose joint coverage and one-step-vs-lambda confounds.
implementation_guidance.diagnostics: Same-query label-clock matrix plus crossed oldcritic/oldencoder, oldcritic/newencoder, newcritic/newencoder; distinguish replay and fresh losses.
